messages.title: The tan your clients ask for — now in your treatment room
messages.preview: Trial the professional formula on a real client before you decide.
messages.headline: The tan your clients ask for. Now in your treatment room.

blocks.html: I’m reaching out because {{BUSINESS_NAME}} looks like the kind of {{BUSINESS_TYPE}} that puts the finished result first.

Sunless by Jimmy Coco brings a Hollywood-led, professional spray-tan system into the booth: natural-looking bronze colour, a polished client experience and a named service you can present as premium rather than generic.
Eligible UK professional partners can request a complimentary 100 ml professional trial sample, shipped free, before making any decision.
Or reply TRIAL and we will keep it straightforward.

messages.title: The details clients notice after their tan
messages.preview: A universal bronze formula and a repeatable professional method.
messages.eyebrow: The result beyond the treatment room
messages.headline: The details clients notice after their tan.

blocks.html: The first test of a professional tan is not the booth lighting. It is how the client feels wearing it afterward — in daylight, photos and the moments they booked it for.

Malibu Professional Spray is a 10% DHA, universal bronze formula with a stated 6–8-hour development window. The professional product page recommends under 35 ml for a full-body session and says the formula works with standard HVLP systems.
For the client, the value is natural-looking, soft-focus colour with a moisture-led formula and fast dry-down. For your team, it is a method they can learn and repeat with confidence.

messages.title: The salon maths behind a premium tan
messages.preview: A clear starting point for your own service-price and stock plan.
messages.headline: The salon maths behind a premium tan.

blocks.html: Premium positioning works best when the operational maths is clear.

The current UK Malibu professional litre is listed at £60 and designed for approximately 28 full-body tans — around £2.14 in solution cost per tan before disposables, card fees, labour, premises and tax.
That does not set your treatment price. It gives you a clearer base from which to price a distinctive, premium named service for your own market and clients.

messages.title: The easiest retail conversation happens after the tan
messages.preview: A simple maintenance, top-up and gift recommendation for the moment clients care most.
messages.headline: Help clients keep the glow between appointments.

blocks.html: The most natural retail moment is just after a client sees a result they love and asks how to keep it looking that way.

items: Self Tan Soufflé: the between-appointment top-up in the right depth.
A-List Glow Kit: the premium routine or gifting option.

blocks.html: That makes retail part of the client’s care plan, not a hard sell at reception. For a mobile professional, the same approach works with a small carry kit and a follow-up order link.

messages.title: Shall I close this for now?
messages.preview: If the timing is not right, we will step back.
messages.headline: I’ll leave the timing with you.

blocks.html: If {{BUSINESS_NAME}} is exploring a premium spray-tan service, Jimmy Coco Pro offers a professional formula to trial on a real client, a clear treatment story, team support to discuss, and useful retail aftercare for clients between visits.
If the timing is right, request your complimentary professional trial. If not, no problem — we will not continue this sequence.
